rows.name: Merck & Co.
rows.thesis: Cheap large drug maker with earnings momentum and a strong price trend; acts as a defensive anchor during the move out of tech.
rows.risks: Keytruda's patent expiry and drug-pricing policy.

rows.name: Nucor
rows.thesis: Leading US steelmaker benefiting from tariff-protected pricing and steady infrastructure demand; the stock is near its 52-week high.
rows.risks: Steel prices falling back if demand softens.

rows.name: Targa Resources
rows.thesis: Pipeline and processing business tied to Permian gas volumes, with fee-based cash flow and buybacks.
rows.risks: Lower Permian drilling activity or weak commodity-linked margins.

rows.name: CrowdStrike
rows.thesis: Top cybersecurity platform with long-term growth; the $495M acquisitions add AI security features.
rows.risks: Very high valuation in a market that is selling tech.

rows.name: Marathon Petroleum
rows.thesis: Q3 adjusted EPS of $26.93 beat estimates, the dividend rose 10%, and MPLX cash flow plus buybacks support the stock.
rows.risks: Refiner margins falling back from peak levels.

rows.name: DuPont
rows.thesis: Its slimmed-down specialty-materials business is earning more money and the stock trend is strong.
rows.risks: Industrial demand slowing, plus PFAS legal costs.

rows.name: Viatris
rows.thesis: Cheap generic-drug maker that is repricing upward on debt reduction, cash returns to shareholders and new pipeline drugs.
rows.risks: Generic price erosion and setbacks at manufacturing plants.

rows.name: Valero Energy
rows.thesis: Most efficient large refiner, with heavy cash returns to shareholders.
rows.risks: Same refiner-margin risk as MPC, which concentrates the energy exposure.

rows.name: NetApp
rows.thesis: Storage company gaining from AI data infrastructure, with high margins and a reasonable valuation.
rows.risks: The AI hardware selloff keeps squeezing its valuation.

rows.name: Morgan Stanley
rows.thesis: Wealth management brings steady fees, and investment banking is recovering.
rows.risks: Weak markets hurting trading and dealmaking revenue.

rows.name: Fortinet
rows.thesis: Revenue grew 20% and billings 29%, guidance went up, and the stock already reflects the bad news.
rows.risks: Stock is volatile and below its 200-day average, so it could keep falling with the sector.

rows.name: Illumina, Inc.
rows.thesis: Raised its full-year revenue forecast to $4.64-4.66B and its EPS forecast to $5.40-5.45; free cash flow is up sharply despite the revenue miss.
rows.risks: Slow growth and research-funding pressure keep the stock from being rerated.

rows.name: Keysight Technologies
rows.thesis: Test-equipment maker benefiting from AI and 6G spending; the latest reported quarter showed 36% revenue growth and the selloff appears to be sector-wide, not company-specific.
rows.risks: Stock is below its 200-day average, and the mid-to-late November earnings report could disappoint.
